properties.text: For all invocations of TransactionTypeError.__init__(transaction_type), the field self.transaction_type must be stored as Final[int] and must be immutable after construction. No subsequent operation may alter transaction_type once assigned.

For all invocations of TransactionTypeError.__init__(transaction_type), super().__init__(msg) must be called before self.transaction_type = transaction_type. The state machine must transition through q_format -> q_super -> q_final in strict order.

For all invocations of TransactionTypeContractCreationError.__init__(transaction), self.transaction must store a reference to the original transaction object, preserving the offending transaction for diagnostic inspection.

For all invocations of TransactionTypeContractCreationError.__init__(transaction), the error message must dynamically include type(transaction).__name__, accurately reflecting the transaction type that violated contract creation rules.

For all invocations of InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError.__init__(transaction_max_fee_per_gas, block_base_fee_per_gas), both fee fields must be stored as Final[Uint] and must be immutable after construction.
InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError is raised if and only if transaction_max_fee_per_gas < block_base_fee_per_gas. The condition is both necessary and sufficient for this exception.

For all invocations of InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError.__init__, both transaction_max_fee_per_gas and block_base_fee_per_gas values are preserved in the exception object for diagnostic inspection, matching the original input values exactly.

All exception classes raised during transaction validation (TransactionTypeError, TransactionTypeContractCreationError, InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError, PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError, TransactionGasLimitExceededError, InitCodeTooLargeError, NoBlobDataError, BlobCountExceededError, BlobGasLimitExceededError, InsufficientMaxFeePerBlobGasError, InvalidBlobVersionedHashError, EmptyAuthorizationListError) must inherit from InvalidTransaction.

For each validation check in the transaction_validation_dispatch (SG-004), the check is mutually exclusive: for any given transaction, each check either passes (transitions to the next check) or fails (raises the corresponding exception), never both and never neither.

The transaction validation dispatch must apply checks in the following strict order: (1) transaction type, (2) contract creation eligibility, (3) max_fee_per_gas vs base_fee_per_gas, (4) priority_fee vs max_fee, (5) gas_limit vs maximum, (6) init_code size, (7) blob-specific checks, (8) authorization list, and must not reorder these checks.

Every error path in the transaction_validation_dispatch must terminate by raising an InvalidTransaction subclass. No error path may silently fail, return a default value, or reach the valid transaction state.

A transaction reaches the valid state (q_valid or q_valid2) in the transaction_validation_dispatch if and only if it passes ALL applicable validation checks. There is no path from q_init to q_valid/q_valid2 that bypasses any required check.

In blob_transaction_validation (SG-005), blob data presence (blob_versioned_hashes is non-empty) must be checked before blob count validation (len(blob_versioned_hashes) <= MAX_BLOB_COUNT). The state machine must transition through q_check_data before q_check_count.

In blob_transaction_validation, gas limit (total_blob_gas <= limit) must be checked before fee sufficiency (max_fee_per_blob_gas >= blob_base_fee). The state machine must reach q_check_gas before q_check_fee.
For all blob versioned hashes in a valid blob transaction, every hash must have version byte == VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01). forall(h in blob_versioned_hashes): h[0] == 0x01.
Blob versioned hash validation must fail on the first invalid hash encountered (short-circuit evaluation). If hash[i] has invalid version, hashes[i+1..n] must not be checked.
The number of blobs per transaction must not exceed MAX_BLOB_COUNT. forall(tx in BlobTransaction): len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes) <= MAX_BLOB_COUNT.
apply_fork must be an identity transformation for the Osaka fork: forall(state): apply_fork(state) == state. No irregular state transition may occur.
get_last_256_block_hashes must return at most 256 hashes. forall(chain): len(get_last_256_block_hashes(chain)) <= 256.
The hashes returned by get_last_256_block_hashes must be in order of increasing block number. forall(i < j): block_number(hashes[i]) < block_number(hashes[j]).
In get_last_256_block_hashes, only the most recent block's hash is computed via keccak256(rlp.encode(header)). All other hashes are retrieved via parent_hash from successor blocks.

A block must be rejected (InvalidBlock raised) if len(rlp.encode(block)) > MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE. The RLP-encoded size of any accepted block must not exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (approximately 8,388,608 bytes).
In post-merge Ethereum, block.ommers must be the empty tuple (). Any block with non-empty ommers must be rejected with InvalidBlock.

After apply_body completes, all 8 computed values (block_gas_used, transactions_root, state_root, receipt_root, bloom, withdrawals_root, blob_gas_used, requests_hash) must exactly match the corresponding block header fields. Any mismatch must cause InvalidBlock to be raised.
After appending a block, the chain must retain at most 255 blocks. forall(chain after state_transition): len(chain.blocks) <= 255.

The base fee per gas can increase by at most parent_base_fee_per_gas // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR per block. forall(block): base_fee_per_gas(block) <= parent_base_fee_per_gas + parent_base_fee_per_gas // DENOMINATOR.
When parent_gas_used > parent_gas_target, the base fee increase must be at least 1. forall(block where parent_gas_used > parent_gas_target): base_fee_per_gas(block) >= parent_base_fee_per_gas + 1.
ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER must equal 2, so the gas target is always gas_limit // 2. forall(block): gas_target(block) == gas_limit(block) // 2.
The block gas limit must pass check_gas_limit validation against the parent gas limit before base fee calculation proceeds. If check_gas_limit fails, InvalidBlock must be raised.
Block number must be >= 1. Any block with header.number < 1 must be rejected with InvalidBlock.
Block timestamps must be strictly increasing. forall(block): block.header.timestamp > parent_header.timestamp. Blocks with timestamps <= parent timestamp must be rejected.
Block numbers must be sequential. forall(block): block.header.number == parent_header.number + 1.
Block header extra_data must not exceed 32 bytes. forall(block): len(block.header.extra_data) <= 32.
In post-merge blocks, header.difficulty must be 0. forall(block): block.header.difficulty == 0.
In post-merge blocks, header.nonce must be 0x0000000000000000. forall(block): block.header.nonce == b'\x00' * 8.
In post-merge blocks, header.ommers_hash must equal EMPTY_OMMER_HASH (keccak256 of RLP-encoded empty list). forall(block): block.header.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH.
Block header parent_hash must equal keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)). forall(block): block.header.parent_hash == keccak256(rlp.encode(chain.blocks[-1].header)).

Block header excess_blob_gas must match the value computed from the parent block via calculate_excess_blob_gas. forall(block): block.header.excess_blob_gas == calculate_excess_blob_gas(parent_header).
Gas used must not exceed gas limit. forall(block): block.header.gas_used <= block.header.gas_limit.

A transaction's gas must not exceed the remaining block gas (block_gas_limit - block_gas_used). forall(tx, block_state): tx.gas <= block_gas_limit - block_gas_used, else GasUsedExceedsLimitError is raised.
A transaction's blob gas usage must not exceed the remaining block blob gas. forall(tx, block_state): calculate_total_blob_gas(tx) <= blob_gas_available, else BlobGasLimitExceededError is raised.
For EIP-1559, Blob, and SetCode transactions: max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas. Violation must raise PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError.
For EIP-1559, Blob, and SetCode transactions: max_fee_per_gas >= base_fee_per_gas. Violation must raise InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError.
Blob transactions must have between 1 and BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT blobs (inclusive). forall(tx in BlobTransaction): 1 <= len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes) <= BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT.
All blob versioned hashes in a valid transaction must use the KZG version prefix 0x01. forall(tx in BlobTransaction, h in tx.blob_versioned_hashes): h[0] == VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG.

Blob and SetCode transactions must not create contracts. forall(tx in (BlobTransaction, SetCodeTransaction)): tx.to must be a valid Address. If tx.to is None or not an Address, TransactionTypeContractCreationError must be raised.
SetCode transactions must have a non-empty authorization list. forall(tx in SetCodeTransaction): len(tx.authorizations) > 0, else EmptyAuthorizationListError is raised.
The sender's account nonce must exactly match the transaction nonce. forall(tx, sender): sender.nonce == tx.nonce, else NonceMismatchError is raised (indicating either 'too low' or 'too high').

The sender's balance must be >= max_gas_fee + tx.value before transaction execution begins. forall(tx, sender): sender.balance >= (tx.gas * effective_gas_price + blob_gas_fee + tx.value), else InsufficientBalanceError is raised.
The transaction sender must be an EOA (empty code) or have a valid delegation designation. If the sender has code and it is not a valid delegation, InvalidSenderError must be raised.
Receipt.succeeded must be True if and only if the transaction execution produced no error. forall(receipt): receipt.succeeded == (error is None).
The receipt bloom filter must be computed from the transaction's logs via logs_bloom. forall(receipt): receipt.bloom == logs_bloom(receipt.logs).

System transactions must always originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe). forall(system_tx): system_tx.origin == SYSTEM_ADDRESS AND system_tx.caller == SYSTEM_ADDRESS.
System transactions must use exactly SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000) gas. forall(system_tx): system_tx.gas == 30_000_000.
System transactions must not transfer value. forall(system_tx): system_tx.should_transfer_value == False AND system_tx.value == 0.
For checked system transactions (process_checked_system_transaction), the target contract must contain code. len(get_account(state, target_address).code) > 0, else InvalidBlock must be raised.
For checked system transactions, execution must succeed without error. If system_tx_output.error is not None, InvalidBlock must be raised.

For unchecked system transactions (process_unchecked_system_transaction), no validation is performed on contract code existence or execution result. The function must not raise InvalidBlock regardless of the execution outcome.

In apply_body, the beacon roots system transaction must execute before any user transactions. The ordering must be: process_unchecked_system_transaction(BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS) happens-before all user transaction processing.
In apply_body, the history storage system transaction must execute after beacon roots and before user transactions. The ordering must be: beacon_roots -> history_storage -> user_transactions.
In apply_body, transactions must be processed in the order they appear in the block. forall(i < j): tx[i] is processed before tx[j].
In apply_body, withdrawals must be processed after all user transactions. The ordering must be: all user transactions -> process_withdrawals.
In apply_body, general purpose requests (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations) must be processed last, after all transactions and withdrawals.
In process_general_purpose_requests, requests must be appended in ascending order of request type: DEPOSIT_REQUEST_TYPE first, then WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_TYPE, then CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_TYPE.

Deposit requests must be parsed from block output logs (via parse_deposit_requests), not from system transactions. Deposit requests originate from user-initiated transactions that interact with the deposit contract.
Withdrawal and consolidation requests must come from checked system transactions (process_checked_system_transaction). These system transactions must not fail, or InvalidBlock is raised.
Gas refund must be capped at gas_used // 5 (EIP-3529). forall(tx): tx_gas_refund <= gas_used // 5.

EIP-7623 calldata floor gas cost must be enforced after refund calculation. forall(tx): tx_gas_used >= calldata_floor_gas_cost. Formally: tx_gas_used = max(gas_used - refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost).

The sender must pay effective_gas_fee (tx.gas * effective_gas_price) plus blob_gas_fee upfront before transaction execution. forall(tx): sender.balance is reduced by (effective_gas_fee + blob_gas_fee) before process_message_call.
Unused gas must be refunded to the sender at the effective_gas_price rate. forall(tx): sender receives gas_left * effective_gas_price after execution.
The miner (coinbase) must receive only the priority fee portion: coinbase += tx_gas_used * (effective_gas_price - base_fee_per_gas). The base fee must not be paid to the miner.
The sender's nonce must be incremented before message execution (process_message_call). forall(tx): increment_nonce(state, sender) must happen-before process_message_call(message).
Accounts marked for deletion (accounts_to_delete) must be destroyed after transaction execution completes, not during execution.
Withdrawal amounts must be scaled by 10^9 (Gwei to Wei conversion). forall(withdrawal): credited_amount == withdrawal.amount * 10^9.
Withdrawal processing must always increase the target account's balance, never decrease it. forall(withdrawal): balance_after(withdrawal.address) >= balance_before(withdrawal.address).
Gas limit change between consecutive blocks must be bounded by parent_gas_limit // GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR (1024). forall(block): |block.gas_limit - parent.gas_limit| < parent.gas_limit // 1024.
Gas limit must be at least GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000). forall(block): block.header.gas_limit >= 5000.
Gas limit cannot change by more than approximately 0.1% per block, ensuring gradual capacity adjustment. forall(block): |gas_limit(block) - gas_limit(parent)| < gas_limit(parent) / 1024.
Raw blob bytes must be exactly BYTES_PER_BLOB in length before being accepted for cell encoding. forall(blob): len(blob) == BYTES_PER_BLOB, else the encoding must fail.
bytes_to_bls_field must validate that input bytes represent a value strictly less than BLS_MODULUS. forall(bytes_input): int(bytes_input) < BLS_MODULUS, else the conversion must fail.

If the KZG trusted setup is honestly generated (asm-001), no computationally bounded adversary can forge a KZG proof that passes batch verification for a polynomial commitment to which they do not know a valid opening.
KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL used in the pairing check must correspond to the same trusted setup ceremony as KZG_SETUP_G1_MONOMIAL. Both must be validated against known checksums before use.

All verifier-relevant data must be included in the Fiat-Shamir hash input for compute_verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_challenge. The hash input must include: domain separator, commitments count, commitment indices, cell indices, all coset evaluations, and all proofs.
The Fiat-Shamir hash input order must be deterministic and canonical. No reordering, injection, or omission of data elements is permitted without changing the resulting challenge r.

For externally supplied inputs to verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch, all inputs must pass exhaustive validation: commitment byte length == BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT, cell index < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, cell byte length == BYTES_PER_CELL, proof byte length == BYTES_PER_PROOF, and all input arrays must have matching non-zero lengths.

A valid proof for one (commitment, cell) pair must not verify for a different cell index or different commitment. The Fiat-Shamir challenge must bind proofs to their specific (commitment, cell_index, cell_data) tuple.

For data recovery (recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs), the following must hold: (1) cell_ids and cells must have matching lengths, (2) at least CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB / 2 cells must be provided, (3) no duplicate cell indices, (4) cell indices must be sorted, (5) all cell indices < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, (6) all cells must have correct byte length.
The recovered polynomial from recover_polynomialcoeff must have degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB. The polynomial must be truncated to the correct degree bound after recovery.
Data column sidecars must be published to the deterministic subnet computed via compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(column_index). Publishing to an incorrect subnet must be detectable.

Custody requirements must be proportional to stake: total_node_balance // BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP, clamped to [VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT, NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS]. forall(validator): VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT <= custody_groups(validator) <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS.
Validators must retain sidecars for at least MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs and must serve them upon request during this retention period.

Transaction sender identity must be recovered via ECDSA signature recovery (recover_sender) using the chain_id and transaction signature. Sender address cannot be specified directly by the transaction submitter.
The ECDSA signature covers the full transaction payload. Any modification to any transaction field must invalidate the signature and cause recover_sender to produce a different address.

Deposit event logs must be filtered by both contract address and event signature. forall(log considered as deposit): log.address == DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS AND log.topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH.

extract_deposit_data must perform exhaustive validation of deposit event data: total data length, all five field offsets, and all five field sizes must match expected values. Any mismatch must raise InvalidBlock.

compute_requests_hash must use SHA-256 to produce a cryptographic commitment over all request data. Multiple independent clients must compute the same requests_hash for the same block, and any mismatch causes block rejection.

State transition must independently recompute all 8 header fields (gas_used, transactions_root, state_root, receipt_root, bloom, withdrawals_root, blob_gas_used, requests_hash) and verify each against the block header. A malicious proposer cannot include invalid header claims.

EIP-7702 Authorization tuple signatures must be verified via ECDSA recovery before acceptance. The chain_id must match for cross-chain replay protection, and the nonce must match the authorizer's current nonce for same-chain replay protection.

The storage_root parameter in encode_account must be a valid 32-byte Merkle root of the account's actual storage trie. State modifications must follow the strict sequence: fee deduction -> nonce increment -> execution -> refund -> miner payment -> cleanup.
decode_receipt must reject any receipt with a type-prefix byte not in {1, 2, 3, 4}. The assertion receipt[0] in {1, 2, 3, 4} must be enforced for all typed receipts received from network peers.

Receipt type prefixes must be injective: 0x01 maps exclusively to AccessListTransaction, 0x02 to FeeMarketTransaction, 0x03 to BlobTransaction, 0x04 to SetCodeTransaction. No two transaction types may share a prefix.

RLP encoding must be deterministic and canonical. The tuple ordering (nonce, balance, storage_root, code_hash) in encode_account must be strictly maintained. Any deviation causes a state root mismatch and block rejection.
The bloom filter's add_to_bloom function must derive exactly 3 bit positions per entry from keccak256 output, each masked to 11 bits (0x07FF) to stay within the valid 2048-bit range.

If a system contract has no code (len(code) == 0) and is invoked via a checked system transaction, InvalidBlock must be raised. If the checked system transaction execution fails, InvalidBlock must be raised. This prevents chain halt from missing system contracts.
The SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe) must be unreachable by normal user transactions. No user-submitted transaction may have SYSTEM_ADDRESS as its sender.

Parent hash verification must be performed cryptographically: header.parent_hash must equal keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)). Any corruption of parent block data must cause this check to fail, preventing blocks with invalid parent references.
An unknown transaction type must cause TransactionTypeError to be raised as the first validation check. The validation dispatch must not proceed to any subsequent checks for unknown types.

Validation checks must be ordered from cheapest to most expensive to minimize wasted computation on invalid transactions. Type check (O(1)) must be first; blob-specific and authorization checks (iterative) must come later.

Gas refund cap combined with calldata floor must prevent gas under-pricing. forall(tx): final_gas_used = max(gas_consumed - min(gas_consumed // 5, refund_counter), calldata_floor_gas_cost). This ensures no transaction pays less than the calldata floor.

EIP-7702 SetCode authorization delegation must require explicit, signed authorization tuples. The authorization list must be non-empty. The sender must be an EOA or have valid delegation code. Blob and SetCode transactions must not create contracts.

Authorization tuples must include chain_id binding for cross-chain replay protection. The nonce must match the authorizer's current state nonce for same-chain replay protection. forall(auth in authorizations): auth.chain_id == current_chain_id AND auth.nonce == authorizer_account.nonce.

At the execution layer, each included transaction must be independently validated regardless of its position within the block. A block proposer cannot include invalid transactions even if they control ordering.

Transactions are cryptographically signed with ECDSA and are non-repudiable. Transactions are recorded in the transactions trie (trie_set) and receipts are generated (make_receipt), providing an immutable audit trail.

All core data structures (Block, Header, Withdrawal, Log, Receipt) must be immutable after construction via the @slotted_freezable decorator. No actor may mutate fields after the freeze operation completes.
The bloom filter bytearray must always be exactly 256 bytes (2048 bits). Under- or over-sized bloom arrays must not be accepted.
The cumulative_gas_used field in Receipt must be monotonically non-decreasing within a block. forall(i < j in same block): receipt[i].cumulative_gas_used <= receipt[j].cumulative_gas_used.

Every transaction must be exactly one of LegacyTransaction, AccessListTransaction, FeeMarketTransaction, BlobTransaction, or SetCodeTransaction. The type discriminator must be exhaustive and no transaction may have an ambiguous type.
For legacy/access-list transactions, gas_price must be >= base_fee_per_gas. Violation must raise InvalidBlock. For EIP-1559/blob/SetCode transactions, effective_gas_price = priority_fee + base_fee.

The Engine API connection between consensus and execution layers must be authenticated (JWT). The parent_beacon_block_root field provides a cryptographic anchor to the beacon chain state for cross-layer integrity verification.

The encode_receipt type-dispatch must cover all defined transaction types. If a new transaction type is introduced, encode_receipt and decode_receipt must be updated. The fall-through to legacy encoding for unrecognized types must be treated as a specification error.
RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN must be globally unique across all protocols using the same hash function, preventing cross-protocol replay attacks against the batch verification scheme.
The FFT implementation must require input length to be a power of 2. forall(vals): len(vals) must be a power of 2 for FFT operations.

The bilinear pairing check e(LL, LR) == e(RL, [1]) in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl must be sound: accepting a batch if and only if all individual cell KZG proofs are valid with respect to their commitments.
divide_polynomialcoeff must never be called with the zero polynomial as divisor. forall(calls to divide_polynomialcoeff): divisor b is not the zero polynomial.
interpolate_polynomialcoeff must receive distinct x-values. forall(calls to interpolate_polynomialcoeff): all x-values are unique (no two x-values are equal).

Withdrawal processing must not require gas costs or sender balance checks. Withdrawals directly increase the recipient's balance unconditionally. forall(withdrawal): no gas is consumed and no balance sufficiency check is applied.

The Merkle inclusion proof for blob_kzg_commitments in get_data_column_sidecars_from_block must correctly target the blob_kzg_commitments field at its correct generalized index in the BeaconBlockBody SSZ tree.

During cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction, proof slicing must be correctly aligned with cells from compute_cells. proofs[start:end] for each blob must correspond exactly to the cells produced for that blob. Misaligned slicing must be detectable via failed proof verification.

After recovery of all cells and proofs, the regenerated cells and proofs must be verified against the original KZG commitment using verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch. Recovery from mutually inconsistent cells (from different polynomials) must be detected by this verification step.

bit_reversal_permutation must be applied consistently across polynomial_eval_to_coeff, coset_shift_for_cell, coset_for_cell, and recover_polynomialcoeff. Inconsistent application would produce incorrect coefficient representations.
